findings.title: GET unsubscribe endpoint mutates notification state
findings.body: The `unsubscribe` action changes the user's `TopicUser.notification_level` while being served by GET routes (`t/:slug/:topic_id/unsubscribe` and `t/:topic_id/unsubscribe`). GET requests can be issued by link prefetchers, email-client previews, crawlers, or third-party HTML using the user's session. Because the new level depends on the current level, repeated or prefetched requests can silently change the subscription (for example watching -> regular -> muted). State-changing operations should require POST/PUT or a confirmation/token rather than occur on page load.

findings.title: NoMethodError when TopicUser record is absent
findings.body: `TopicUser.find_by(user_id: current_user.id, topic_id: params[:topic_id])` can return nil for a logged-in user who has no existing TopicUser row for the topic. The following `tu.notification_level` call will raise NoMethodError and return a 500. The action should upsert the TopicUser (for example with `find_or_initialize_by` plus sensible defaults, or via `TopicUser.change`) instead of assuming the row exists.

findings.title: Unsubscribe does not consistently mute the topic
findings.body: The endpoint downgrades tracking/watching topics to `regular` instead of `muted`. Regular is not the same as muted and can still produce notifications for interactions such as mentions or replies, so a user clicking an unsubscribe link may continue receiving notifications. If the feature is meant to stop notifications for that topic, set the level to muted or make the desired target level explicit.

findings.title: Direct save bypasses TopicUser.change bookkeeping
findings.body: Instead of using `TopicUser.change`, the action updates the row with `save!`. `TopicUser.change` is the established path for notification-level changes: it sets `notifications_changed_at` and `notifications_reason_id` and publishes a MessageBus notification-level change. Bypassing it can leave client state out of sync and lose the reason/audit information for the subscription change.

findings.title: Global unsubscribe_link now requires unsubscribe_url
findings.body: The `unsubscribe_link` translation now includes `%{unsubscribe_url}`. `Email::MessageBuilder` appends/renders `unsubscribe_link` whenever `add_unsubscribe_link` is true, but only notification emails were updated to provide `unsubscribe_url`. Existing or plugin emails that set `add_unsubscribe_link` without supplying this new interpolation key will raise `I18n::MissingInterpolationArgument` when building the email body or HTML part. Use a separate key, provide a safe default, or make the topic-specific line conditional.

findings.title: Missing tests for new unsubscribe endpoint
findings.body: No controller/request specs were added for the new unsubscribe endpoint. Tests are needed for successful notification-level changes, missing TopicUser rows, unauthorized or private topics, slug redirects, JSON versus HTML responses, and repeated GET requests.
